baseline: create table orders (id integer primary key, reference text not null); insert into orders values (1,'DEMO-01');
forward: alter table orders add column dispatched boolean not null default false;
verify: select count(*)=1 and bool_and(dispatched=false) as ok from orders;
rollback: alter table orders drop column dispatched;
verify_rollback: select count(*)=1 and bool_and(reference='DEMO-01') as ok from orders;
impact: Adds a dispatch marker. Demo-only fixture. Production baseline and rollback data loss need separate review.
recovery: Restore the pre-change backup if new dispatch values must be retained. Rehearsal checks the supplied baseline only.
